newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Equipment Q1 beats expectations.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Equipment Q1 beats expectations.

text.p: Specialty Equipment Cos Inc, a food service equipment supplier, said Tuesday its earnings for the first quarter ended April 30 exceeded company expectations.
Earlier, it reported first quarter earnings of $0.38 a sahre, up from $0.33 a year ago. Sales for the quarter rose to $109.2 million from $105.3 million.

"The sales increase primarily reflected very healthy demand for our refrigeration and glass door merchandising equipment at our Beverage-Air division," Jeffrey Rhodenbaugh, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "International sales were also an important contributor to our growth, constituting 34 percent of sales for the quarter."
The company added that it continued to reduce long-term debt. As of April 30, net outstanding debt stood at $130.7 million, down 10 percent from January 31.
"Our strengthened balance sheet gives us the flexibility to aggressively expand our market leadership positions and pursue acquisition opportunities," Rhodenbaugh said.
